slides.title: The Rocky Horror Picture Show: A 40th Anniversary Special
bullets: Fox is developing a two-hour remake of the 1975 cult classic to be directed, executive-produced, and choreographed by Kenneth Ortega.
The project, tentatively titled "The Rocky Horror Picture Show Event," is casting-contingent.

slides.speaker_notes: The Rocky Horror Picture Show is getting the small-screen treatment. Fox is developing a two-hour remake of the 1975 cult classic, directed, executive-produced, and choreographed by Kenneth Ortega.

slides.title: Key Creative Team and Producers
bullets: Kenneth Ortega: Director, Executive Producer, and Choreographer
Gail Berman and Lou Adler: Executive Producers

slides.speaker_notes: Kenneth Ortega, known for his work on High School Musical, is at the helm of this project. Gail Berman and Lou Adler, who produced the original film, are also attached as executive producers.

slides.title: Celebrating the 40th Anniversary
bullets: The special is timed to celebrate the 40th anniversary of the film, which has grossed over $112 million and still plays in theaters across the country.
The 40th anniversary marks a significant milestone for the film.
This milestone is a testament to the enduring popularity of the Rocky Horror Picture Show.
slides.speaker_notes: The 40th anniversary of the Rocky Horror Picture Show is a significant milestone. The film has grossed over $112 million and still plays in theaters across the country.

slides.title: Previous Attempts at Adaptation
bullets: This isn't the first stab at adapting "The Rocky Horror Picture Show."
In 2002, Fox unveiled plans for an adaptation timed to the 30th anniversary that never came to fruition.

slides.speaker_notes: There have been previous attempts at adapting The Rocky Horror Picture Show. In 2002, Fox unveiled plans for an adaptation that never came to fruition.

slides.title: Upcoming Live Productions
bullets: Fox also has a live musical production of "Grease," starring Julianne Hough and Vanessa Hudgens, scheduled to air on January 31, 2016.
Following in the footsteps of "The Sound of Music" and "Peter Pan," NBC recently announced plans to air a live version of The Wiz later this year.
These live productions showcase the enduring appeal of classic musicals.
slides.speaker_notes: Other live productions are also on the horizon. Fox's live production of Grease and NBC's live production of The Wiz are upcoming events.

Fox is developing a two-hour remake of the 1975 cult classic to be directed, executive-produced and choreographed by Kenneth Ortega ("High School Musical").

The project, tentatively titled "The Rocky Horror Picture Show Event," is casting-contingent.

The special will be filmed in advance and not air live, but few details beyond that are known.

evidence.chunk_content:
In addition to Ortega, Gail Berman and Lou Adler, who produced the original film, are also attached as executive producers.

The special will be produced by Fox 21 Television Studios, and Berman's The Jackal Group.

The special is timed to celebrate the 40th anniversary of the film, which has grossed more than $112 million and still plays in theaters across the country.

TV premiere dates: The complete guide .
